pins.llama_cpp_pinned_by: CCode 2026-10-06: github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp release b11440, asset fetched through the session proxy and hashed in the scratchpad (17,693,628 bytes); newer tags b11443-b11445 carried no Ubuntu x64 asset yet. Not installed anywhere.
pins.llama_cpp_files_pinned_by: CCode 2026-10-06: the pinned asset (sha256 verified = llama_cpp_sha256) extracted in the session scratchpad into an empty directory; every regular file of its one top directory hashed (50 files; the 10 .so symlinks are not files). llama_cpp_sha256 is the ARCHIVE and is verified only at fetch time by the setup script; the installed runtime is llama-server plus the shared libraries beside it (llama-server NEEDS libllama-server-impl.so, which NEEDS libllama-common, libmtmd, libllama, libggml, libggml-base; libggml loads the libggml-cpu-* variants at run time; libssl.so.3 and libcrypto.so.3 come from the host). The gate and the setup script verify the extracted files against this manifest, never the binary against the archive hash. Static read of the bytes (strings, readelf; nothing executed): /apply-template, /tokenize with add_special, json_schema response_format, /v1/chat/completions, --no-context-shift are present in this release.

proposed_runtime_parameters.note: CONFIRMED by Greg 2026-10-06 (in chat, 'They looked fine to me', to CCode's recommended set after the proposed values were reviewed). Changes from the proposal: temperature 0.2 -> 0.0 (greedy decoding, so a turn and any facilitator failure in the one E2E reproduce); max_meeting_seconds 1800 -> 3000 (fits the workflow's 60-minute timeout with the pinned fetches; on 2 cores a worst-case 6-turn item is about 10 minutes, so about 5 such items are reached, the rest listed open); threads 8 -> null = the host's online CPU count read at launch (a GitHub standard runner for a private repository has 2; a fixed 8 would oversubscribe it), recorded in the meeting record; input_token_cap_per_call is now ENFORCED in code (each call's input is counted with the server's /tokenize; an over-cap item is left open by code with the count, never truncated by the server's context shift). Unchanged: top_p (moot at temperature 0), 400 output tokens per turn, 16384 context, 6 coordinator turns per item. All unmeasured until the one authorized E2E.
proposed_runtime_parameters.confirmed_by: Greg Davis, 2026-10-06, in chat to CCode
proposed_runtime_parameters.threads_rule: null = the host's online CPU count at launch (os.cpu_count()); an integer is clamped to that count; the value used is written to the record's runtime.effective
